Class BlockRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.happyuky7.openvoxelmoding.loader.BlockRegistry
public final class BlockRegistry extends Object
Registry of ModLoader blocks, addressed by namespaced ids like Fabric/Minecraft (modloader:chest, mymod:ruby_block). The engine's block enum cannot be extended, so every registered block is stored in the world as a real engine "base" block (collision, mining, lighting) plus a ModLoader entry with its id, which is what makes it render and behave as the modded block. Entries are saved per world by
